binding.label: PRIVATE_CALIBRATION_CAUSAL_COPY_NOT_QUALIFICATION
binding.base_vs_production: Exact local calibration candidate plus identical separately bound private instrumentation. No qualification or readiness claim.
binding.history: Original code,T0 scenario at all widths, then original code,T1 warmup and all16 seed oracles, then width1.

source_binding.retained_runtime_patch_scope: 2ac to local798; not an additional patch to798

private_diagnostic_limits.target_shape: Exact rows 0..32 only; calls_above32 explicitly counted; existing legacy bins clamp above32.
private_diagnostic_limits.counter_unrecorded_head_last: Route predicate only, not proof of frontend prefill versus queued decode.
private_diagnostic_limits.copy_float_encoding: decimal IEEE754 u64 bits; null retained for unknown.
private_diagnostic_limits.counter_perturbation: bounded samples/fences and encoder rotation; not performance qualification.
private_diagnostic_limits.command_gpu_ms: Raw command-buffer stopwatch; reject if invalid/outside calibrated CPU envelope before interpreting.
private_diagnostic_limits.class_gpu_ms: two-point calibrated GPU counter samples; unsupported/invalid fails.

source_binding.candidate_calibration_scope: Admitted residency and committed head/calibration buffers, before preparing tap destinations; no target math, dtype, trial, driver or oracle change.

binding.target_counter_phase_labels: decode/prefill in old aggregate snapshots mean recorded/unrecorded, including queued decode; exact per-forward fields are separately named.
